data: Is 90 the maximum possible value of UAS?

The caption states that the figure shows UAS accuracy for the average models (BERT 13, ELMo 3) on incoming dependencies of different part-of-speech categories. The x-axis represents UAS values ranging from 0 to 100. The y-axis lists various part-of-speech categories. The bars represent the UAS values for four models: BERT-UD, BERT-SUD, ELMO-UD, and ELMO-SUD. The highest bar in the chart is approximately at 90, which corresponds to the DET category. Therefore, the maximum possible value of UAS is likely to be 100, not 90. However, based on the data presented in the figure, the maximum value appears to be around 90.
